keyFindings.description: Security[authz]: checkDeployRun re-reads the run attempt from GitHub and holds it to the workflow path, branch, head repository and event (outbox.go:1442-1474), but not to its status. The envelope is trusted for nothing (intake/facts.go WorkflowRunCompleted comment), and Envoy accepts a source=github publish from any bearer holder. A forged `completed` envelope for a real release/deploy run that is still in progress, after its Apply step succeeded, wakes the check before the run ends. It also consumes the per-job event ids (check-wake:<issue>:<check>:deploy run:<run>:<attempt>:<job>, outbox.go:1540) that ApplyFact deduplicates, so the genuine completion later adds no look. The look then may report pending against a run with no conclusion (agent-infra's check instructions read a run once it has a conclusion) and the check waits for another wake or its bound - the gap this issue closes. Fix: decode `status` from GET /actions/runs/{run}/attempts/{attempt} (the field is there: run 40184206819 attempt 1 reads `completed success`) and wake nothing, logged, unless it is `completed`, whatever the conclusion; a regression test with an in_progress attempt followed by the completed one of the same run, attempt and job.
